entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello? I... I need some help. I bought something and I think I need to send it back. I'm just so confused by the website.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. I can certainly help you with that. To start, could I get your name and the order number?
Yes, it's Sarah Jenkins. The order number is... uh... VF88-12945.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it works fine, I think. It's just... I'm not really a cyclist. It was a total impulse buy. I thought it would do something else, and I just don't use it. I've basically just changed my mind about the whole thing.
I see. So it's not defective, you've just decided it's not the right product for you. I understand.

Exactly. I saw something online about a policy, but I couldn't figure it out. I even thought about looking for a resale website, but that's all too complicated. Can't you just help me? I just want to return it.
Of course, Sarah. Let me just pull up the official return policy for your item. One moment.
Okay, thank you for holding. I've got the policy right here. It looks like your VeloBand Cadence Sensor is eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, really? So I can send it back?
Yes, absolutely. Since you received it 36 days ago, you are well within that 90-day window. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now and email you a pre-paid shipping label.
Wow, that's such a relief! Thank you so much, David. I was so worried I was stuck with it.

You're very welcome, Sarah. I'm happy I could get this sorted out for you. I've just sent that email with the return label and instructions. Once we receive the item, you can expect a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's perfect. You've been a great help. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
